architecture: one MPFB head / cheek / chin target set (CF2 = balanced central); CF1 = 0.55 x CF2, CF3 = 1.6 x CF2 (capped at 1.0); identical target keys and signs for configuration 1 (FNL4) and configuration 2 (FNF181); height macro held (body skeleton unchanged); eye-scale / eye-height targets kept
design_method: probe responses of 24 MPFB head-region targets at 0.5 on FNL4 (cf_probe_eval.py) -> bounded ridge least squares (0..0.6, lambda 1) toward canon-direction descriptor departures; nose / mouth targets excluded by rule (order §4.5)
